Ongoing detail analysis of existing B&H finish goods inventory levels reveals critically low volumes of various
packings at the planned production start-up date of March 26, 2001. in order to prevent major hardships on
Production Planning, Manufacturing and Inventory Deployment areas, it is the recommendation and approval of
the DRB to move the production start date to April 2, 2001.
All other milestones up-stream remain the same. Please inform others in your area.
